About

01

I run day-to-day marketplace operations for Afaq Al Hasoub, a Saudi Arabia–based e-commerce business, working remotely from Egypt. My focus is on the parts of e-commerce that decide whether a listing actually sells: accurate pricing, clean product data, inventory that matches fulfillment reality, and reporting that catches problems before they become losses.

Before e-commerce, I spent four years in retail sales and management — leading a sales team at a real estate company and running daily store operations at LC Waikiki. That background shapes how I work now: numbers matter, but so does the customer at the end of the listing.
